lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in semi-regular horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of spots, forming a distinct grid-like matrix across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear features along the upper flank characterized by a high-contrast transition from light upper surfaces to shadowed lower surfaces.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced notch/tissue loss on the trailing edge of the right pectoral fin; dark elongated appendages (remoras) visible near the base of the pectoral fin.
